disclaimer: The Cycle is for training and recovery context only. It is not medical advice, not a diagnostic tool, and must never be used for contraception or fertility planning. Predictions are estimates from the dates you log.
settings.trackingDesc: Log the first day of your period; Shape reads your phase and the patterns that come with it. Private to you unless you share it.
settings.shareDesc: Your linked coach(es) see your phase and recent start dates — so training and food can follow your week. Turn it off any time.
settings.shareOffDesc: Available once cycle tracking is on.
settings.stopDesc: Deletes every date you logged and stops sharing. This cannot be undone.
optIn.body: Log the first day of your period and Shape reads the rhythm — where you are in your cycle, and what usually shows up there for you in sleep, energy and training.
optIn.privacy: It stays yours. Nothing is shared with a coach unless you turn sharing on, and stopping deletes every date you logged.
optIn.done: Cycle tracking on — log your last period to begin.
share.consent: I agree to share my cycle phase and recent period start dates with my linked coach(es). I can turn this off at any time.
optOut.title: Stop tracking and delete?
optOut.message: This deletes every date you logged and turns off cycle tracking. If you were sharing with a coach, that stops too. This cannot be undone.
optOut.done: Cycle tracking stopped — your dates are deleted.
err.unavailable: Cycle setup isn't available yet. Try again shortly.
